message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Publish Docs to GitHub Pages

permissions:
  contents: write

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.x

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install mkdocs-material

      - name: Build docs
        run: mkdocs build

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          personal_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./site
",
  "rationale": "Add a pip dependency cache before installation, matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download caching pattern and the measured Python example that restores ~/.cache/pip keyed on pyproject.toml. The repository contains pyproject.toml and the job installs a Python package with pip, so repeated dependency fetching is reduced while every build/deploy step, trigger, and permission is preserved unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
